verdict.rationale: Canva documents public REST APIs (the Connect APIs) for integrating its capabilities into other platforms, covering assets, designs and comments. It also publishes an OpenAPI description for generating client SDKs, plus SCIM and Admin APIs, an MCP server and an llms.txt index. The probes did not find the OpenAPI file at common paths, but that does not contradict the documented claim. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec location (probed paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Canva REST APIs let you integrate Canva's capabilities into your own web apps and platforms.
You can use the REST APIs to build web apps that create and sync assets, designs, comments, and more.
Canva provides an OpenAPI description of the REST APIs.
The Canva Admin API lets you manage teams, groups, and users in a Canva organization.
